notes.zh: 回答云上 8 卡 H100 实例的 CPU、内存与互联配置，可与同类实例逐项对照。关键差异在 CPU 与内存配比：本实例 96 vCPU / 1900 GiB，同类其他厂商给到 192 vCPU / 2 TiB，数据加载型任务会先撞 CPU 与内存，而不是 GPU。不回答价格与配额。
notes.en: Answers the CPU, memory and interconnect configuration of an 8-GPU H100 cloud instance so it can be compared item by item with peers. The decisive difference is the CPU-to-memory ratio: this instance pairs 96 vCPUs with 1,900 GiB where a comparable offering provides 192 vCPUs and 2 TiB, so data-loading workloads hit CPU and memory limits before the GPUs. It does not answer price or quota.

specs.networking: 8 NICs; 3.2 Tbps interconnect per VM; 400 Gbps InfiniBand per GPU
